meta.notes: The career's fourth bike (playtest 3, round 3: "Six bikes"; docs/product-spec.md, Bikes). About 136 mph (61.0 m/s), 9% faster than the Streetfighter 750, so it is a clear step up; heavy and long-legged, so it steers a little slower, hits 15% harder and shrugs off 30% of a shove. On sale in the Pacific Northwest's second tier for $25,500, about 3 races of winnings after it opens for a typical player (the playtest 3 plan's model, not a measurement). Its model is a byte copy of the touring flagship's under its own id (`models/bikes/grand-tourer-1100`), until Codex draws its own under the same name.
